stem:
A company employee had to read several financial reports. The scatterplot shows the lengths and reading times for those reports.

Which prediction of the time in minutes to read a 90-page report is best supported by the data?
visual_elements: scatterplot titled Report Reading Times with x-axis labeled 'Number of Pages in Report' from 0 to 100, y-axis labeled 'Time to Read Report (min)' from 0 to 100, 7 points plotted around x values 20, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60 and y values 22, 41, 50, 48, 66, 69, 83
